Case note: Anticipatory Bail Application No. 303/2019
Client: Abhishek Bose (bank manager, Kolkata)
Opposing party: Venkat DSouza
Court: Kolkata Sessions Court
Filed on: 19/09/2019
Claim amount: ₹31,10,000
Issue: anticipatory bail. The complaint alleges negligence during treatment.
Advice given: Rely on the expert committee opinion that there was no gross negligence.
Outcome: Anticipatory bail was granted on the strength of the expert opinion.
Recommended next step: Apply for quashing of the case.
